blocks.text: A specialist shares its generalist's hull: it costs a fee per gun more and changes only the damage it deals (see Combat > Variants).

The backbone of your economy. Right-click an asteroid and it shuttles ore back to a starbase on its own; orange-flecked rocks carry spice. Asteroids run dry, so your miners push ever outward as a belt empties.
blocks.title: Mining Barge

blocks.text:
needs Gas Skimming
Drinks minerals from gas giants and spice from nebulae. In a nebula, right-click a spot and the skimmer thins the gas around it pixel by pixel, moving on to the nearest gas left until the cloud is gone.
blocks.title: Gas Skimmer

blocks.text: Carries the first settlers to a free world and is used up founding the colony. Alone, a colony ship is an easy kill.
blocks.title: Colony Ship

blocks.text: Raises your empire's stations and gives itself to the work: a starbase, Mining Station, Shipyard, Frontier Outpost, Warp Gate or Field Wall Generator.
blocks.title: Constructor

blocks.text:
Deep Sensors: Sees far, into spice nebulae and through ion storms.
Cheap, fast and unarmed, it exists to see. Its sensors reach far, into spice nebulae and through ion storms, and the beacons it drops keep watch long after it has moved on.
blocks.title: Scout

blocks.text: Keeps a fleet alive between battles. Armor never comes back any other way, so a tender turns a battered fleet into a fresh one without the long trip home.
blocks.title: Repair Tender

blocks.text: Support ship for Radiation zones. The shield is a bubble that soaks fire and blocks Radiation for everything inside; touching bubbles merge into a Mega Shield. Disruptor shots pass through, and an Inhibitor hit knocks the bubble offline. Unarmed.
blocks.title: Radiation Sail Array

blocks.text: The cheap, quick heart of any fleet. Short-ranged and lightly built, it wins by numbers.
blocks.title: Corvette

blocks.text:
needs Destroyers
A tough, armored escort with two light turrets that track their target without turning the hull, and the longest reach of the small hulls.
blocks.title: Destroyer

blocks.text:
needs Cruisers
Heavy shields and three laser turrets that outrange everything smaller. It is slow to turn, so anything that stays off its nose can punish it.
blocks.title: Cruiser

blocks.text:
needs Carriers
The fleet's flagship: its shields and armor dwarf its hull, and four independent turrets let it fire in every direction without ever coming about. Its Mods trade the turrets for drones, tractor beams or long-range missile salvos.
blocks.title: Carrier
